## Preparing the work space

```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
require("knitr")

```
### Loading required packages and scripts
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
```

## Assigning a palette that will be re-used throughout the clustering
```{r}
palette <- c("B-cells" = "#7FB3D5",
              "T-cells" = "#1F78B4",
              "uNK" = "#08519C",
              "Macrophages" = "#3182BD",
              "Hofbauer" = "#4A6FA9",
              "Monocytes" = "#08306B",
             "Erythroid" = "#6A3D9A",
             "Platelets" = "#8A2BE2",
             "Uterine epithelial" = "#FFD92F",
             "DSC" = "#E6AB02",
             "Endothelial (M)" = "#C71585",
              "Endothelial (F)" = "#D87093",
              "Endothelial" = "#E996AF",
              "Fibroblast" = "#A6761D",
              "Pericytes" = "#A0522D",
              "SMC" = "#E5C494",
             "Visceral" = "#D9D9D9",
             "Parietal" = "#969696",
             "Trophoblast" = "#00BFC4")
```
## Mouse Atlas
```{r}
Atlas <- readRDS("../ReferenceFiles/Atlases/Complete/MouseCompleteAtlas_FinalVersion_26thMay2026.rds")

## Extracting trophoblasts and renaming to match the palette
troph <- Atlas@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(cell.class == "Trophoblast") %>%
  pull(cell.type.short) %>%
  unique()
Atlas@meta.data$cell.type.for.plot <- Atlas@meta.data %>% 
  mutate(cell.type.for.plot = case_when(cell.type.short == "Bcells" ~ "B-cells", 
                                        cell.type.short == "Tcells" ~ "T-cells", 
                                        cell.type.short == "EndoM" ~ "Endothelial (M)", 
                                        cell.type.short == "EndoF" ~ "Endothelial (F)", 
                                        cell.type.short %in% troph ~ "Trophoblast", 
                                        cell.type.short == "UterineEp" ~ "Uterine epithelial", 
                                        cell.type.short == "ParietalYS" ~ "Parietal", 
                                        cell.type.short == "VisceralYS" ~ "Visceral", 
                                        .default = cell.type.short)) %>% 
  pull(cell.type.for.plot)

## Assigning identity
Idents(Atlas) <- "cell.type.for.plot"
p1 <- DimPlot(Atlas, cols = palette) + NoLegend() + theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/CompleteAtlas_Mouse_UMAP.png", plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/CompleteAtlas_Mouse_UMAP.pdf", plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)

## Clear up
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("palette")))
```

## Create a legend for the plots above
```{r}
legend_data <- data.frame(cell_type = names(palette), color = palette)
rownames(legend_data) <- NULL
legend_data$category <- c(rep("Leukocytes", 6), rep("Other Blood Cells", 2), rep("Uterine", 2), rep("Stromal", 6), rep("Yolk Sac", 2), "Trophoblast")
legend_data$y <- c(11:6, 4,3, 1,0,11:6, 4,3,1)
legend_data$x <- c(rep(0,10), rep(1,9))
legend_data

## Dummy plot
p_legend <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cell_type), size = 5) +  # colored box
  geom_text(aes(label = cell_type), hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.2, size = 4.5, family = "Arial") + # cell type labels
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(legend_data$color, legend_data$cell_type)) +
  # Add category headers as text (we place them manually)
  geom_text(
    data = subset(legend_data, !duplicated(category)),
    aes(x = x - 0.2, y = y + 1, label = category),
    hjust = 0.3, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 5, family = "Arial"
  ) +
  xlim(-0.5, 2) +   # space for labels
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# Save figure
ggsave("Visuals/CompleteAtlases_UMAP_Legend.png", plot = p_legend, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
